definition: Required raw input completeness and eligibility plus frozen mapping-contract readiness; does not require later human normalization, qualitative or valuation completion. Retained blocked facts are explicit but not considered ready. Candidate only; no formal admission.

rows.fundamentalBoundary: Conservative completeness/eligibility of existing required raw paths, separate from human/scoring/valuation completion. Required excluded facts remain blockers; merely retaining a blocked fact is not readiness. Candidate-only, not formal admission.
